description: This file defines interfaces for process container management within the WPEFramework, including enumerations for network interfaces, memory info, processor info, container instances, and a container administrator singleton. It specifies the structure for interacting with, managing, and querying containerized processes, network interfaces, and resource usage.

classes.name: INetworkInterfaceIterator
classes.description: Interface to iterate over network interfaces, providing methods to obtain interface name, number of addresses, and specific IP addresses.

classes.name: IMemoryInfo
classes.description: Interface to access memory usage statistics such as allocated, resident, and shared memory.

classes.name: IProcessorInfo
classes.description: Interface to access CPU usage metrics, including total usage, per-core usage, and core count.

classes.name: IContainer
classes.description: Represents a container, enabling access to its ID, PID, resource usage, network interfaces, status, and control methods for starting and stopping the container.

classes.name: IContainerIterator
classes.description: Interface to iterate over containers, primarily to retrieve container IDs.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates a new container instance based on specified ID, search paths, log path, and configuration.

methods.name: Logging
methods.description: Enables logging for the container framework with specified log path and options.

methods.name: Containers
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all existing container instances.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific container by its ID, returning nullptr if not found.

ctags.pattern: /^    class IContainerIterator : public Core::IIterator, public Core::IReferenceCounted {$/
